tools.name: invite_interviewer_to_candidate_panel
tools.description: Gives an interviewer access to a candidate's profile and scorecard in the applicant tracking system at the chosen access level, then emails them a notice about the invitation.

params.name: candidate_id
params.description: ID of the candidate in the applicant tracking system

params.name: interviewer_email
params.description: Email address of the interviewer being invited

params.name: access_level
params.description: Access level to grant: viewer, scorer, or coordinator

tools.code:
import os
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage

import requests
from agents import function_tool

ATS_BASE_URL = os.environ.get("ATS_BASE_URL", "https://ats.internal.example.com/api/v2")
ATS_API_TOKEN = os.environ.get("ATS_API_TOKEN", "")
SMTP_HOST_NAME = os.environ.get("SMTP_HOST", "smtp.example.com")
SMTP_PORT_NUMBER = int(os.environ.get("SMTP_PORT", "587"))
SMTP_LOGIN_USER = os.environ.get("SMTP_USER", "")
SMTP_LOGIN_PASSWORD = os.environ.get("SMTP_PASSWORD", "")
RECRUITING_SENDER_ADDRESS = "recruiting@example.com"

_ALLOWED_ACCESS_LEVELS = {"viewer", "scorer", "coordinator"}


@function_tool
def invite_interviewer_to_candidate_panel(
    candidate_id: str, interviewer_email: str, access_level: str = "scorer"
) -> str:
    normalized_access_level_value = access_level.strip().lower()
    if normalized_access_level_value not in _ALLOWED_ACCESS_LEVELS:
        return f"Invalid access level '{access_level}'. Choose one of: {sorted(_ALLOWED_ACCESS_LEVELS)}"

    permission_grant_request_payload = {
        "user_email": interviewer_email.strip().lower(),
        "role": normalized_access_level_value,
        "resource_type": "candidate",
    }
    permission_grant_http_response = requests.post(
        f"{ATS_BASE_URL}/candidates/{candidate_id}/permissions",
        json=permission_grant_request_payload,
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {ATS_API_TOKEN}"},
        timeout=15,
    )
    if permission_grant_http_response.status_code >= 400:
        return (
            "Could not grant access: "
            f"{permission_grant_http_response.status_code} {permission_grant_http_response.text}"
        )

    candidate_review_link = f"{ATS_BASE_URL.replace('/api/v2', '')}/candidates/{candidate_id}"
    invitation_email_message = EmailMessage()
    invitation_email_message["From"] = RECRUITING_SENDER_ADDRESS
    invitation_email_message["To"] = interviewer_email
    invitation_email_message["Subject"] = "You have been added to an interview panel"
    invitation_email_message.set_content(
        f"You now have {normalized_access_level_value} access to candidate {candidate_id}.\n"
        f"Review the profile here: {candidate_review_link}\n"
    )

    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST_NAME, SMTP_PORT_NUMBER) as smtp_connection_to_server:
        smtp_connection_to_server.starttls()
        smtp_connection_to_server.login(SMTP_LOGIN_USER, SMTP_LOGIN_PASSWORD)
        smtp_connection_to_server.send_message(invitation_email_message)

    return (
        f"Granted {normalized_access_level_value} access on candidate {candidate_id} "
        f"to {interviewer_email} and sent the invitation email."
    )

tools.name: purchase_skills_assessment
tools.description: Looks up a candidate and the assessment price, charges the company's payment account for the assessment, and gives the candidate access to take it.

params.name: candidate_id
params.description: ID of the candidate who will take the assessment

params.name: assessment_id
params.description: ID of the assessment to buy

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3

import stripe
from langchain_core.tools import tool

from internal_clients import assessment_acl

stripe.api_key = os.environ.get("STRIPE_API_KEY", "")
DB = os.environ.get("RECRUITING_DB", "recruiting.db")
CUSTOMER = os.environ.get("STRIPE_COMPANY_CUSTOMER", "")


@tool
def purchase_skills_assessment(candidate_id: int, assessment_id: str) -> str:
    db = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    try:
        c = db.execute(
            "SELECT email, status FROM candidates WHERE id = ?", (candidate_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        a = db.execute(
            "SELECT name, price_cents FROM assessments WHERE id = ?", (assessment_id,)
        ).fetchone()
    finally:
        db.close()

    if c is None:
        return f"Candidate {candidate_id} not found"
    if a is None:
        return f"Assessment {assessment_id} not found"
    email, status = c
    name, cents = a
    if status in ("rejected", "withdrawn"):
        return f"Candidate is {status}; purchase cancelled"

    try:
        pi = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
            amount=cents,
            currency="usd",
            customer=CUSTOMER,
            confirm=True,
            off_session=True,
            description=f"Assessment {name} for candidate {candidate_id}",
            idempotency_key=f"assess-{candidate_id}-{assessment_id}",
        )
    except stripe.error.StripeError as e:
        return f"Payment failed: {e}"

    if pi.status != "succeeded":
        return f"Payment not completed (status {pi.status})"

    assessment_acl.grant(
        user_email=email,
        resource=f"assessment:{assessment_id}",
        permission="take",
        expires_in_days=7,
    )
    return f"Charged {cents / 100:.2f} USD (payment {pi.id}) and gave {email} access to '{name}' for 7 days"

tools.name: finalize_hire_handoff
tools.description: Moves an accepted candidate's folder from the pending-hires area into the onboarding area, gives the new hire's manager access to it, and emails the manager that the hire is ready.

params.name: manager_email
params.description: Email address of the hiring manager receiving the handoff

tools.code:
import shutil
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage
from pathlib import Path

from langchain_core.tools import tool

from internal_clients import iam_client

PENDING_ROOT = Path("/srv/hr/pending_hires")
ONBOARDING_ROOT = Path("/srv/hr/onboarding")


@tool
def finalize_hire_handoff(candidate_id: str, manager_email: str) -> str:
    source_folder = PENDING_ROOT / candidate_id
    if not source_folder.is_dir():
        return f"No pending folder for candidate {candidate_id}"
    ONBOARDING_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    destination_folder = ONBOARDING_ROOT / candidate_id
    shutil.move(str(source_folder), str(destination_folder))

    iam_client.grant(
        principal=manager_email,
        resource=str(destination_folder),
        role="onboarding_editor",
    )

    message = EmailMessage()
    message["From"] = "hr@example.com"
    message["To"] = manager_email
    message["Subject"] = f"New hire {candidate_id} is ready for onboarding"
    message.set_content(f"The onboarding folder is ready at {destination_folder}.")
    with smtplib.SMTP("smtp.example.com", 587) as server:
        server.starttls()
        server.send_message(message)

    return f"Moved {candidate_id} to onboarding, granted access to {manager_email}, and sent notice"
